name: Bloom Charity Nfp
mission: BLOOM Charity’s mission is to support vulnerable children around the world with a holistic approach to their health and well-being. Our programs support mental health, nutrition, early childhood development, and education.
theoryOfChange: BLOOM Charity, NFP is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization dedicated to improving the quality of life and long-term outcomes for at-risk, vulnerable children and orphans with a focus on early childhood development, mental & physical health, food security, education and psychosocial needs.BLOOM Charity is also dedicated to building networks of support, virtual support groups for vulnerable populations so they can find comfort in connecting with others that have a shared life experience.

strengths_deep_dive: Bloom Charity demonstrates exceptional financial efficiency in its service delivery model. In FY2024, the organization operated with <cite id="1">a 98.7% program expense ratio</cite>, allocating nearly all funding directly to child enrichment and emergency food response. This ratio comfortably exceeds standard peer benchmarks. Charity Navigator awards the organization <cite id="1">an overall score of 89.5/100</cite>.

The charity balances direct crisis intervention with permanent infrastructure. Program reports show that in FY2024 alone, direct aid efforts distributed <cite id="5">700,000 meals in Gaza</cite>. Concurrently, capital construction projects completed <cite id="5">11 PlayGardens</cite>, establishing recreational access for <cite id="5">15,000 families in rural Morocco</cite>. The organization tracks key outcome metrics across all primary operational locations.
rich_narrative.summary: Bloom Charity Nfp provides critical play spaces and emergency aid to children facing crisis situations in Morocco and Gaza. Founded in 2015, the organization focuses on early childhood development, outdoor enrichment, and crisis relief. In FY2024, the charity experienced strong early-stage growth, <cite id="2">raising $551,810 in revenue</cite> to support its growing international scope. Financial efficiency remains exceptionally high, with <cite id="1">98.7% of expenses directed to program services</cite> in FY2024. The organization holds <cite id="1">an overall rating of 89.5/100 from Charity Navigator</cite> and maintains a Candid Platinum Seal of Transparency. Operational impact spans both PlayGarden construction and direct humanitarian distributions. In Gaza, the organization provided <cite id="5">700,000 emergency meals</cite> alongside mental health support events. In rural Morocco, it constructed free recreational parks and PlayGardens that <cite id="5">served 15,000 families</cite> and multiple orphanages. Bloom Charity maintains <cite id="3">explicit zakat eligibility</cite>, serving needy families across conflict-affected and underserved regions.
